item.research_question: How can computational methods be adapted or developed to address the compositional and configurational complexity of multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs) for structural applications, specifically regarding structure generation, interatomic potentials, and machine learning descriptors?
item.material_system: Multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs) including BCC HfNbTaTiZr, FCC CoCrFeMnNi, CoCrMoxNi, Al0.5CoCrCuFeNi, Ti0.25CrFeNiAlx, TiZrHfNb, TiZrHfAl, RhIrPdPtNiCu, CoFeNi, NbMoTaW, CoCrFeNi, CoCrNi, FeNiCuCoCr, MoNbTaTiV, CuFeNiCrCo, and Al-Co-Cr-Cu-Fe-Ni systems
item.processing_route: Computational design utilizing atomistic structure generation algorithms (Neural evolution structure (NES), Order through informed swapping (OTIS)), Density Functional Theory (DFT), Classical Molecular Dynamics (MD) with various Interatomic Potentials (EAM, Moment tensor potentials (MTP), Low-rank potentials (LRP), Gaussian approximation potential (GAP), Random Fourier feature (RFF), Spectral neighbor analysis potential (SNAP)), and Machine Learning (ML) models (ANNs, decision trees, linear regression) trained on experimental or computational databases
item.test_conditions: Simulations performed at various scales (up to 40,000+ atoms for NES, hundreds of thousands for OTIS), temperatures including cryogenic and high-temperature (above 600°C), and under conditions of ion irradiation; experimental comparisons made on alloys processed via cold rolling, annealing, and as-cast states
key_findings: The Neural evolution structure (NES) generator can create structures with over 40,000 atoms at a reasonable computational overhead of a few hours on 40 processors, significantly reducing complexity compared to SQS.

In BCC MoNbTi, dislocations can glide on higher-order planes, and local slip resistance (LSR) is positively correlated with lattice distortion while anisotropy in LSR is reduced with lattice distortion.

A theoretical model utilizing DFT data (solute misfit volumes, lattice constants, elastic constants, stable stacking fault energies) was developed to predict yield strength in RhIrPdPtNiCu without experimental inputs.

Thermodynamic integration aided by Moment tensor potentials (MTP) offers a four-times speedup compared to DFT-based approaches with less than 1 meV/atom error on high-temperature free energy predictions.
An iterative computational-experimental process in the Al-Co-Cr-Cu-Fe-Ni system identified 42 new candidates, of which 35 had higher hardness than the original dataset, reaching a maximum of 883 HV.
A novel MPEA designed using a database of 370 MPEAs achieved a hardness of 920 HV, outperforming the top original dataset alloy by almost 25%.
In the NbMoTaW refractory HEA system, strengthening was found to be due to the segregation of Nb to the grain boundaries leading to short-range order (SRO).
Stacking fault tetrahedra (SFTs) were identified in CoCrNi medium entropy alloy during irradiation damage, where tetra-vacancy clusters have positive binding energy in CoCrFeMnNi.
item.mechanism: The authors argue that unique MPEA properties arise from maximized configurational entropy stabilizing solid solution phases, severe local lattice distortion (LLD) affecting friction stress and yield strength, and element-resolved local lattice distortion (ELLD) driven by charge transfer. Plasticity is governed by compositional inhomogeneities making kink nucleation rate-limiting and creating local slip resistance (LSR) that traps dislocations. Radiation tolerance is enhanced by biased elemental diffusion inducing SRO, higher defect recombination rates, and suppressed damage accumulation. Machine learning models identify correlations between descriptors (e.g., atomic radii, electronegativity, mixing enthalpy) and properties like phase stability and hardness.
item.limitations: The text states that SQS generation scales poorly with system size, ab initio methods face size and timescale limitations for dislocation motion, classical potentials miss complex chemical interactions, and current interatomic potentials struggle to model non-equiatomic compositions with micro-alloying. Additionally, experimental databases suffer from discrepancies due to fabrication methods, and ML models often lack interpretability.
item.future_work: The authors propose better integration of thermodynamic models with ab initio calculations, exploring real-space DFT and efficient sub-space diagonalization, developing reliable interatomic potentials for the periodic table, addressing the disconnect between structure generation algorithms and thermodynamic stability, creating comprehensive computational databases, improving feature selection methods for ML, and enhancing the interpretability of ML models.
quotes: NES can bring down the computational complexity of structure generation dramatically and has been utilized to create structures with over 40,000 atoms at a reasonable computational overhead (a few hours on 40 processors).
A theoretical model has been developed utilizing data from first-principle calculations to predict the yield strength in RhIrPdPtNiCu high-entropy alloy.

Thirty-five of the newly synthesized alloys were measured to have higher hardness values than the best ones in the original dataset, consisting of 155 samples, and the highest hardness reached 883 HV.
